question: Convert my scissor pick-and-place recording into a LeRobot dataset.
ground_truth: This prompt converts a scissor_pick_and_place recording with uv run --project tools/dataset i4h-dataset convert <recording> <runs/.../lerobot/local/name> --robot so101 --repo-id local/<name> --successful-only --task <scissor task prompt>, then verifies the LeRobot metadata, parquet, and H.264 videos.
expected_behavior: routes to i4h-workflow-dataset-convert
maps scissor pick-and-place to scissor_pick_and_place and its scene soarm_scissors
takes --robot so101 and the task text from the scissor_pick_and_place task manifest
writes the dataset to a new directory under runs/scissor_pick_and_place/<timestamp>/lerobot/
creates LeRobot parquet, aggregate stats metadata, and H.264 videos for the room and wrist cameras
reports the LeRobot dataset path

question: Prepare my latest HDF5 recording for training by converting it to a LeRobot dataset.
ground_truth: This prompt converts the latest HDF5 recording under ./runs with i4h-dataset convert, using the embodiment and task prompt of the policy task it will train, and verifies the metadata a trainer needs.
expected_behavior: routes to i4h-workflow-dataset-convert
resolves the latest HDF5 recording and identifies its scene and workflow
takes --robot and --task from the target policy task manifest, or the scene manifest's embodiment
converts it into LeRobot parquet, aggregate stats metadata, and H.264 videos
checks that state comes from obs/joint_pos and reports when the recording lacks it
verifies meta/modality.json when the trainer requires it and reports a missing modality instead of calling the dataset complete
passes one --patient-twin per recording for an endoluminal recording
uses --g1-wbc-policy-actions only for a 23-D G1 keyboard recording that must train a 50-D policy
reports the converted dataset path for training

question: Convert and visualize the recorded data.
ground_truth: This README continuation converts the recording produced by the preceding my_workflow rule-based run and then hands the completed LeRobot output to the browser visualizer.
expected_behavior: routes first to i4h-workflow-dataset-convert
resolves the preceding my_workflow HDF5 recording
converts all successful episodes to a LeRobot dataset with i4h-dataset convert and verifies its metadata and videos
routes the completed LeRobot dataset to i4h-lerobot-viz
opens the viewer with tools/dataset/scripts/viz.sh and reports its local URL
does not try to visualize the raw HDF5 recording as LeRobot data
